audit.why: Chart and phase text agree: Tristana favored throughout on both layers, consistent with her longer effective range and burst outpacing Ezreal's poke-only kit in lane.

Spikes correctly key level 3 (E stacking punishes Arcane Shift cooldown), level 6 (Buster Shot vs Trueshot Barrage), first item (burst vs his slower tear scaling), and late (jump range beats his poke).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, and dosFull[2].d each cite a cooldown number ('nineteen seconds', 'fifteen-second invitation') that does not match Arcane Shift's actual cooldown (26/23/20/17/14s by rank) or any other Ezreal ability. This is a magnitude stated without a real source.
audit.why: The kit file gives Arcane Shift's per-rank cooldown as 26/23/20/17/14. Neither 19 nor 15 appears anywhere in that curve, so the stated punish window was fabricated rather than sourced.
audit.corrected: Replaced the invented numbers with the real per-rank cooldown range in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, and dosFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Ezreal Arcane Shift: matchup-defining — The blink makes him untouchable — punish the nineteen seconds after he burns it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ezreal Arcane Shift (E) is 26/23/20/17/14s — matchup-defining: the blink makes him untouchable, punish the window it's down. Count it out loud. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: The blink makes him untouchable — punish the nineteen seconds after he burns it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: The blink makes him untouchable — punish the 14-26s it's down, rank-dependent. Bait it, count it, then go.

edits.after: Four stacks detonate the bomb: plant E, land two autos, then decide — step back at three or commit at four.

edits.after: Ezreal burns Arcane Shift on nothing — take the 14-to-26s invitation, rank-dependent.
